record_title: A 0.553 lower bound for four-color rainbow Schur triples
provenance: Explicit four-color interval construction improving the k=4 lower bound in the rainbow-Schur multiplicity problem considered by Hegde, Kumar and Pratibha (arXiv:2609.18474v1) and introduced by Parczyk and Spiegel.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result is a lower bound only: it does not improve the 3/4 upper bound, prove existence of the limiting four-color density, determine the optimum, or establish uniqueness or local optimality of the interval pattern. No new lower bound for k>=5 is claimed. The motivating preprint is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous work remains the principal residual literature risk. Exact computation and finite enumeration support the construction, but the proof rests on the exact area formula and Riemann-sum argument. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
